primary_population: evidence-present flawed-advice items, family equal weight
secondary_contrasts: P7-P3 and P7-P8 within each type
all-item, aligned-advice and missing-evidence accuracy strata
pairing: All review programs share exact same P0 text per item/repeat; complete-pair sensitivity reported separately from planned denominator.
repair: fraction correct after review among same-group incorrect evidence-present P0; denominator zero => null/NA
damage: fraction incorrect after review among same-group correct evidence-present P0; denominator zero => null/NA
ceiling: Always finish fixed800; accuracy interactions remain arithmetically computable at ceiling but do not establish mechanism isolation. Conditional repair is undefined when no P0 errors.
inference: Descriptive development experiment with 4 families/type; no population superiority, equivalence or human-school outcome claim. No confirmatory p-value or power claim.
case_screening: Anonymous internal same-family review before freeze, no external expert.
resource_reporting: Actual subject usage across attempts separated from 800 planned tasks; authoring/review/management overhead unknown and excluded with explicit label; cost NA unless billed/priced usage verified.
